gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

gripOrHq.title: Hostile Takeover
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 4 meat damage.

gripOrHq.title: Chance Observation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

gripOrHq.title: On-Call Solo Team
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

heapOrArchives.title: Trojan Horse
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Audit of Call Records
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted two or more runs during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

discardCards.title: Social Engineering
discardCards.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

discardCards.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

root.title: Trojan Horse
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

root.title: Audit of Call Records
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted two or more runs during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.
